message.content:
An editorial illustration depicts two men flanking a red wheelbarrow filled with a dark, lumpy material resembling coal. On the left, a man wearing glasses, a white dress shirt, and a blue vest with a yellow logo scratches his head while looking down. On the right, a man in a white long-sleeved shirt and black trousers stands with one hand on his hip and the other on the wheelbarrow's handle.

The background features two large, dark-blue industrial smokestacks with white rings near the top, set against a muted blue-gray sky. Above the men, the word "TEMPO" is printed in large, light-gray capital letters. The main headline reads "RIBUT-RIBUT MATI LAMPU" in bold white text. Smaller white text below it discusses "Menteri Energi Bahlil Lahadalia dan PLN" regarding electricity issues. Other headlines at the top mention "Sengkarut Siaran Berbayar Piala Dunia H.24" and "Saling Salip Menyidik Korupsi BGN H.66." The bottom includes date and price details: "29 JUNI-5 JULI 2026," "RP 60.000," and a barcode. A red rectangular bar sits at the top left corner.
